title: The Ultimate SMP Wither Cannon - 1.17+ - WMC
description:
Hi guys ! 

V2 will be out soon to make it 360° !

Before making this cannon in your world/server, you will need some details.
- Not paper proof
- Not bedrock edition proof
- This cannon should be for version 1.17 + (for  powder snow)
- The python script for this cannon is ok if you shoot in the positive/positive direction. It should also work if you rotate the cannon but you might need to chance some parameters
